resources.name: Tarrant County Emergency Management
resources.summary: County emergency management office for all hazards. Runs Tarrant Ready Alerts, the county's official mass notification system.

resources.name: Tarrant Ready Alerts
resources.summary: Free, opt-in county alerts by cell phone, landline, email or text, such as tornado warnings and chemical incidents. You must register; Dry Run never registers you. Also keep Wireless Emergency Alerts turned on in your phone's settings.

contact.phoneNote: 24 hours. Text OUT to 66267 to report if enrolled in MyOncor Alerts; text REG to 66267 to enroll. For downed power lines, leave the area and call 9-1-1.

resources.name: Oncor outage reporting and MyOncor Alerts
resources.jurisdiction: Oncor delivery area (most of Tarrant County; some homes are served by an electric cooperative or city utility)
resources.summary: Report an outage and get outage status updates. Your bill shows which company delivers your electricity.

contact.phoneNote: Your physician submits the state form to the utility. Critical care designation lasts two years; chronic condition designation is usually 90 days.

resources.name: Oncor critical care and chronic condition designation
resources.publisher: Oncor Electric Delivery / Public Utility Commission of Texas
resources.summary: For a household member who depends on an electric-powered medical device to sustain life, or has a serious chronic condition. Designated customers can get notice of planned interruptions and some disconnection protections. Designation does NOT guarantee uninterrupted electricity, so a backup plan is still needed.

contact.phoneNote: Emergency line listed by Atmos Energy. If you smell gas, leave first, then call from a safe place.

resources.name: Atmos Energy gas emergency line
resources.jurisdiction: Atmos Energy service area (natural gas for much of Tarrant County)
resources.summary: Natural gas emergencies such as a suspected leak.

contact.phoneNote: 24/7 for water emergencies, select option 1. Other Tarrant cities have their own water utility.

resources.name: Fort Worth water emergencies
resources.publisher: City of Fort Worth Water Department
resources.jurisdiction: City of Fort Worth water customers
resources.summary: Report water main breaks and water service emergencies, and ask about boil-water or other advisories.

resources.name: Fort Worth Office of Emergency Management alerts
resources.summary: The city's CodeRED sign-up was suspended by its vendor in November 2025. Fort Worth still sends Wireless Emergency Alerts and posts on social media as #FWOEM. Keep Wireless Emergency Alerts on, and sign up for Tarrant Ready.
